notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Sunstrike Legionnaire by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
